annotation.title_clean: 商务部等7部门关于实施品质电商“五优”行动的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Commerce and Six Other Departments on Implementing the "Five Excellences" Action for Quality E-commerce
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 商务部; 中央网信办; 国家发展改革委; 工业和信息化部; 农业农村部; 市场监管总局; 国家邮政局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese notice from the Ministry of Commerce and six other departments launching a "Five Excellences" action to foster quality e-commerce: platform quality governance, merchant support, quality consumption, Silk Road e-commerce, and standards and self-regulation. AI appears only in passing, for example AI-enabled e-commerce agents and consumption scenarios.
key_provisions_or_claims: Platforms to publish quality commitments and quality governance reports and to establish chief quality officers
Support for SME merchants through training and brand building
Promote AI integration with e-commerce, including intelligent agent service models
Accelerate e-commerce standards and curb disorderly price competition such as auto-price-matching
Build national e-commerce industry organisation and self-regulation codes
